Director; member of Audit Committee and Finance and Technology Committee
Board expansion from nine to ten directors
Former CEO and Executive Director of Freddie Mac (2021–2024); 24 years at Wells Fargo in home lending, most recently EVP & Head of Home Lending; current director of NVR, Inc.
